terms: Own-use rights for public data; raw bulk republication as a competing trust directory requires written agreement (terms section 8, 2026-09-16). This file is a small attributed analytical summary, not a raw dataset.
competitor_functionality: Trust/uptime scoring and payment-envelope compliance checks
Alternative endpoint discovery and semantic search

evidence_strength.competitor_features: Verified as publicly advertised in OpenAPI/website, NOT independently tested or purchased
evidence_strength.endpoint_counts_and_quality: Publisher-reported aggregate only, NOT independently reproduced or comparable to x402 List service counts
evidence_strength.customer_or_revenue_signal: None; advertised paid API pricing does not establish paid conversion

strategic_readout: Generic x402 trust scoring, endpoint monitoring and quality routing are directly contested by a public low-ticket incumbent. Do not invest in an undifferentiated x402 trust directory or monitoring clone without a demonstrable differentiated outcome, buyer evidence and lawful data rights. Preserve Phase 0 and prioritize independent supplier exception-resolution outcomes or other measurable workflows.
limitations: Source endpoints, resources, services, hosts, pay-to wallets and distinct businesses are different denominators; do not compare 352165 endpoints directly with x402 List service counts.
Reachability and compliance reflect publisher's own probe methods/vantage and are not independently verified delivery-after-payment.
The public report and API expose multiple flow totals with different/unclear scopes; no market-wide revenue estimate is taken from them.
Pricing is publicly advertised, not an observed purchase, paid customer count or verified realized price.
No new AgentMine paying customers, revenue, observed supplier savings, cost-incurring calls or paid deployment.
